newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos eyes expansion in U.S..
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos eyes expansion in U.S..

text.p: Santos Ltd said on Monday its wholly-owned subsidiary Santos USA Corp is well-placed to expand its interests by up to nine exploration blocks in the Central Gulf of Mexico.

Santos said its position has been enhanced in the region following bidding the the U.S. Offshore Continental Shelf Lease Sale Number 166 on March 5, in which Santos USA was the high bidder on the nine blocks.
Santos USA currently has interests in eight blocks and produces 3.1 million cubic feet of gas and 476 barrels per day of liquids in the Gulf of Mexico, the company said.
Santos USA is part of a joint venture with Murphy Exploration and Production Co and Callon Petroleum Co
Murphy Exploration holds a 60 percent stake in the joint venture, and Santos USA and Callon each hold 20 percent interests, Santos said.
